references.text: Jesus' words about losing one's life to find it, with an identical contrast between loving and hating one's own life.
The same logic that whoever wants to save their life will lose it, while whoever loses it for God's sake will keep it.
A direct parallel using the word 'soul' (psyche) and describing how whoever tries to save their life will lose it.
Paul expresses the same paradox: to live is Christ, but to die is gain, reflecting the willingness to lose one's own life to serve a higher purpose.
